summary.text: Gracey Van Der Mark is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 72 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Chris Kluwe.
Her campaign website describes her as a Huntington Beach city councilmember and former mayor.

paragraphs.text: Gracey Van Der Mark was born to immigrant parents and grew up in Los Angeles, according to her campaign website.

The site says she was the first Latina to serve as mayor of Huntington Beach and that since her election to the city council she has focused on fiscal responsibility, parental rights and public safety support.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
